auth.heading: 2. Authentication and user account
auth.intro: Access to the platform is provided via a directory service. The following data is stored in our database:
auth.outro:
Passwords are not stored on this platform; authentication is handled exclusively against the directory service.
Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (e) GDPR (performance of a task carried out in the public interest).
Retention period: until the user account is deleted.

cookies.heading: 3. Cookies and local storage
cookies.intro: This platform uses only technically necessary cookies and storage mechanisms:
cookies.sessionBody: An HttpOnly cookie used for authentication (valid for 24 hours). Without this cookie, login is not possible.
cookies.storageBody: Temporary storage of filter settings in the browser (automatically cleared when the tab is closed).
cookies.outro: No tracking, analytics or marketing cookies are used. Cookie data is not shared with third parties.

jobs.heading: 4. Processing of user uploads and job data
jobs.intro: When you use the platform, uploaded files (e.g. videos, PDFs, presentations, audio files) and the results derived from them (e.g. transcripts, summaries) are stored in your workspace. For each processing job, the following metadata is also stored:
jobs.retention: Uploaded files and the results derived from them remain stored in your workspace until you or a workspace administrator deletes them. Job metadata for individual processing jobs is automatically removed after no more than 7 days.

thirdParty.heading: 5. Third parties and external AI services
thirdParty.intro: To provide the AI features, content is transmitted to external services:
thirdParty.kisskiBody: Language models and transcription services. Texts and audio content are processed in this context. KISSKI is a service of Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) and is subject to German data protection law. Processing takes place under a data processing agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR.
thirdParty.outro: Only the content required for the respective function is transmitted. The third-party providers do not retain the data beyond the duration of processing.

logs.heading: 6. Server log files
logs.intro: When this website is accessed, the web server automatically records information in so-called server log files. This includes:
logs.item1: IP address of the requesting device
logs.retention: This data is automatically deleted after no more than 7 days.

ssl.heading: 7. SSL/TLS encryption
ssl.body: The platform uses SSL/TLS encryption to securely transmit data. You can recognise an encrypted connection by the browser address bar starting with "https://".

legalBasis.heading: 8. Legal basis
legalBasis.body: Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest) for server logs, and on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract) for user data and job processing within the scope of platform usage.

rights.heading: 9. Your rights as a data subject
rights.intro: You have the following rights vis-à-vis the data controller regarding personal data concerning you:
rights.item4: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
rights.item6: Right to object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR)
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, please contact:

complaint.heading: 10. Right to lodge a complaint
complaint.body: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The competent authority is the Unabhängiges Landeszentrum für Datenschutz Schleswig-Holstein (ULD Kiel) (Independent State Data Protection Centre of Schleswig-Holstein).
